concerns.text: T016 explicitly states 'DO NOT fail the task if success_rate < 95%'. This silently relaxes the acceptance criterion in spec.md (US-1, Scenario 1) which mandates '≥ 95% of rows have valid molecular graphs'. A task that allows the deliverable to fall short of the spec's success definition is a constraint violation.

T036 implements a sensitivity sweep on 'descriptor value thresholds' (filtering molecules by Gasteiger charge magnitude). This deviates from FR-006 and spec.md (US-3, Scenario 2) which require a sweep of 'descriptor inclusion cutoffs' (i.e., which features are included in the model). The task changes the *what* of the requirement (feature selection logic vs. data filtering) without a documented constitutional amendment.

T029 implements 'graph masking' (zeroing node features) to satisfy FR-008. The spec requires 'removing top SHAP features' to measure the drop in R². While the Plan justifies 'graph masking' as a proxy, the task description does not explicitly state this is a *substitution* for the spec's 'removal' requirement, nor does it reference the Plan's Constitution Check. This risks a semantic weakening where the task delivers a different method than the spec demands.

T035 re-trains on a 'stratified sample (N=2000)' to verify SC-004 (SHAP consistency). The spec's SC-004 requires measuring consistency for the 'final model' (implied full dataset). Using a small proxy sample without an explicit 'staged' or 'proxy' label in the task description (beyond the internal logic) risks delivering a result that does not satisfy the success criterion's intent for the full model.
